Container.Name: qwen38-flash-next-rocm
Container.Overview: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B MoE, 6B active, qwen4exp: Gated DeltaNet + Qwen Sparse Attention + 51B n-gram table) served by llama-server on AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) via ROCm 10.0. [br]Image is kyuz0's rocm-10.0-qwen-3.8-flash-next toolbox, which tracks drluoto/llama.cpp:strix-halo-flash-next for GPU TOP_K, native MTP speculative decoding, and ngram-mod drafting. ROCm is required for this model: the 47.7 GiB n-gram table exceeds Vulkan's 4 GiB max buffer binding, so Vulkan containers OOM at load. [br]All runtime config lives in /config/start.sh (seeded from the repo on first boot — edit it there to change model, MTP, vision, context, or slots). No container environment variables are used. GGUFs: unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF (UD-IQ4_XS fits 128 GB with 262k ctx), MTP sidecar from drluoto/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MTP-GGUF. [br]Thinking mode is on by default; allow generous max_tokens in clients.
Container.Description: Strix Halo-only (gfx1151) llama-server with MTP + ngram-mod speculation, tuned per drluoto's measured run line. Port 6631 (llama.cpp's new default). Configure via /config/start.sh on the appdata share — no env vars.
